xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5358: Memory facts: select by relevance into prompts, not only a budget-cut launch list

plan.title: Memory facts: select by relevance into prompts, not only a budget-cut launch list
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 25 files, but the quality lint counts 9 subsystems only because tests/unit, tests/lib and each top-level doc file (configuration/memory.mdx, docs/CONTEXT-LAYERS.md, changelog.d/pan-5358.md, sync-sources/skills) count separately. All code is one feature in src/lib/memory plus its CLI verbs and one additive contract field; every item is a small vertical slice with its own tests, and the issue asks for retrieval, the always-on launch set and write-time vectors together.

narratives.Problem: Curated memory facts reach an agent only through the launch index, which sorts by type and date and stops at a 12,000-character budget, so in dfai 89 of 171 active facts never reach the agent. Prompt-time injection (injectPromptTimeMemory) never considers facts, and the only query-based fact lookup (matchMemoryFacts) ANDs every word, so a raw prompt matches almost nothing.
narratives.Proposal: Add curated facts as a ranked candidate group ('facts', 1,500-token budget, at most 6 facts) of prompt-time injection, ranked by field-weighted BM25 with a relevance floor, and log them in rag-runs. Add an 'always' frontmatter flag whose facts lead the launch index and are excluded from retrieval. Add optional semantic re-ranking: the CLI embeds facts at write time (pan memory add/edit, pan memory sync, new pan memory reindex) through the docs index's existing embedding path into a global content-hash vector cache, and prompt-time ranking fuses lexical and vector ranks with a pseudo-relevance centroid, never embedding the prompt and never loading a model in the dashboard server. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-5358.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Shrinking any launch-index budget or changing its overflow line text.
- Embedding the prompt (query-time embedding) or importing @huggingface/transformers / calling an embedding API from the dashboard server or prompt-time injection.
- Changing matchMemoryFacts, pan memory search, or pan memory list --query semantics.
- Per-session dedupe of injected facts.
- Changing the <overdeck-memory-context> notice or adding separate trust framing for facts.
- Adding per-turn injection to harnesses that lack it (codex, opencode, kimi-code, grok, acp).
- Automatic pruning of the vector cache, or refreshing vectors from pan sync or the dashboard.
- Implementing #4373 (Jev relevance filter).
- An async twin of readMemoryFactsSync in store.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: The launch index keeps its budgets and overflow line; always facts only sort first.
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex, opencode, kimi-code, grok and acp agents get no per-turn injection, prompt-time injection can be disabled or time out, and no existing fact carries the new flag, so shrinking the index would hide facts. rag-runs fact logs will show coverage before any later shrink.

autoDecisions.summary: Vectors are computed only by CLI paths at write time; prompt-time ranking uses a pseudo-relevance centroid of stored vectors and never embeds the prompt.
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured cold gte-small load is about 630 ms and adds about 250 MB RSS, which does not fit the 750 ms hook window or the dashboard process; the docs index already uses the centroid technique.

autoDecisions.summary: Fact embeddings reuse the docs embedding config (docs.embedding, default local gte-small) via a new embedText export in src/lib/docs/index-builder.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to reuse an existing embedding path rather than add a third; this is the one with a local default.

autoDecisions.summary: One global vector cache at ~/.overdeck/cache/memory-fact-vectors.json keyed by content hash, never pruned automatically.
autoDecisions.rationale: Project facts arrive by git merge, not only by pan memory add; a content-hash key lets a vector computed in a workspace serve the same fact in the primary checkout. Entries are about 2 KB and facts change rarely.

autoDecisions.summary: Facts budget is 1,500 tokens and at most 6 facts per injection; each fact injects its description, its body cut at 1,200 characters, and a pan memory show hint.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing sibling and knowledge-index budgets; the body is the detail the launch index tells agents to open.

autoDecisions.summary: Facts already listed in the launch index remain retrieval candidates; always facts do not; no per-session dedupe.
autoDecisions.rationale: The index carries one line per fact while retrieval carries the body; always facts are guaranteed first in the index; observations are not deduped either.

autoDecisions.summary: The project store read at prompt time is the identity's primary checkout (getProjectByKey(projectId).primaryPath), plus the operator and machine stores.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same store the launch index renders and the same resolution readPinnedDocCandidates uses; MemoryIdentity carries no path.

autoDecisions.summary: RagDecision.allocations.facts is Schema.optional and docType gains 'fact'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Additive and backward-compatible for any stored payload; no emitter of MemoryHealthChangedEvent.ragDecision exists in src.

autoDecisions.summary: The fact ranker scores the full prompt/expansion text (stopwords removed, at most 400 terms) with a floor that counts only matches in the fact head: two discriminating terms, or one rare term.
autoDecisions.rationale: The 12-term searchQuery keeps only the first 12 words, which on the spawn surface are orchestration boilerplate; a query-length floor would inject noise for two-word prompts and reject a long prompt whose only link to a fact is one rare word.

items.title: Add the lexical fact ranker (BM25 with head/rarity floor) in src/lib/memory/facts/rank.ts

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-1 and 'Design > Ranker' steps 1-7 (lexical only; the vectors parameter is declared and ignored until vector-rerank): in src/lib/memory/search.ts rename KEYWORD_STOPWORDS to an exported ReadonlySet PROMPT_KEYWORD_STOPWORDS with no behaviour change to buildPromptKeywordQuery. Create src/lib/memory/facts/rank.ts exporting FACT_RETRIEVAL_LIMIT = 6, FACT_QUERY_MAX_TERMS = 400, VECTOR_ONLY_MIN_SIMILARITY = 0.9, RankedFact, tokenizeForFacts (token length >= 3; strip one of ing/ed/non-ss s with the stated remainder minimums, then drop one final e when the remainder is >= 4; never strip 'es' as a unit) and rankFactsForQuery. The query is the full prompt/expansion text, tokenized, stopwords removed, at most 400 terms (NOT the 12-term searchQuery). Floor: eligible when bm25 > 0 and either >= 2 distinct discriminating query terms (df <= ceil(N/2)) occur in the fact head (id words, title, description, tags) or >= 1 rare query term (df <= max(2, ceil(N*0.02))) occurs in the head. Pure module, no I/O. Write the named tests listed in PRD WI-1.

items.title: Given facts where only one description names the query topic, rankFactsForQuery returns that fact first, and returns [] when no fact contains any query term

Given a 200-fact fixture, rankFactsForQuery rejects a fact whose head shares only one common (df 20) term with the query, and accepts a fact whose head holds one rare query term inside a 400-word prompt

For the prompt 'commit and push', rankFactsForQuery returns only facts whose head names both words, and when the topic word appears after the first 12 words of a prompt the matching fact is still returned
tokenizeForFacts returns one token for each family: reconnect/reconnecting, merge/merges/merged/merging, cache/caches/cached, issue/issues
rankFactsForQuery never returns more than FACT_RETRIEVAL_LIMIT facts and returns [] for an empty fact list or a stopword-only query

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-9: add an injectable refreshVectors?: typeof refreshStoreVectorsBestEffort to MemoryFactAddOptions and MemoryFactEditOptions; after a successful write and before printWriteResult call it with [{ dir: target.dir, scope: target.scope }]; on { ok: false } print 'vector index not refreshed: <reason>; run pan memory reindex' to stderr in yellow.
